subject: Next steps & billing details for Redwood pilot - PO vs Card
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + billing info we'll need for pilot

Hi Lisa -

Great to meet you and the Acme team on today's discovery call. Quick recap and the next steps so procurement can move forward with the pilot: 

Summary of ask:
- 3-month pilot, 2 dedicated nodes, expected monthly token volume ~500M tokens
- Primary data residency: us-west-2

Commercial path options we discussed:
1) Payment by corporate card (fastest) 
- project can start as soon as PO/CC is provided and credits cleared.
2) Purchase order + invoice (common for enterprise procurement) 
- we can accept PO and invoice monthly; need billing contact details and PO template if you have one.
3) Marketplace procurement (Azure/AWS) 
- can run through marketplace if procurement prefers consolidated billing; slightly longer timeline for registration.

Billing ops details we need to confirm:
- Legal billing name and billing address (for invoice)
- Tax/VAT ID if applicable
- Preferred payment terms: Net 30 / Net 45 / PCard
- PO routing contact and email

I attached a quick invoice template and a short MSA summary to show required invoice fields. Can you confirm the billing contact and whether procurement prefers PO vs card vs marketplace? Once we have that I'll loop in finance to generate the formal quote.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm billing contact + PO timing (by EOD Wed 9/2?)
- If PO path: send any PO template or routing instructions
- If card: let me know the cardholder and process for transaction approval

Thanks - happy to jump on a 15-min call with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template_v1.pdf (pdf), Redwood_MSA_summary.docx (docx)

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>

Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers from procurement side: 

- Acme Health (legal name): Acme Health, Inc.
- Billing address: 120 Harbor Drive, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Tax ID: 94-1234567
- Preferred terms: PO with Net 30 is our standard.
- PO routing: procurement@acmehealth.com (cc'd) - they use an internal Coupa instance; if you need a PO template I can request one but procurement prefers we send a quote and they will generate the PO.

Marketplace: procurement is open to marketplace purchases but they need to assess cloud spend visibility; might be slower than PO.

We can do a short 15-min call Wednesday 9/2 at 11am PT to confirm fields if that works for you.

Thanks,
Lisa

Hi Marissa / Aditya -

11am PT Wednesday works for our procurement lead, she asked that you please send the quote and the invoice template beforehand so they can generate the PO during the call. If possible include a line that shows tax treatment (we're US-based so no VAT, but local sales tax may apply) and the bill-to vs remit-to fields.

Procurement also requested the following on the invoice: 
- Purchase order number field (blank until generated)
- Itemized line for monthly committed capacity + any estimated overage rate
- Remit-to address and wiring instructions (if they elect ACH/wire)

We'll push for the PO generation on the call. See you Wednesday - pls add the DocuSign link for the SOW if you want procurement to kick that step off.

Best,
Lisa
